name: Work At Height - Safety Training
summary:
Falls from height remain one of the leading causes of serious workplace injury. Work at Height lets your team build the right habits in VR, where a wrong step teaches a lesson instead of causing harm.

Trainees step onto a realistic elevated worksite and work through the task the way they would on the job. Inspect the harness and lanyard, check the work area for hazards, select a safe anchor point and clip on before moving to the edge.
